verdict.rationale: 1Password's Watchtower feature is documented as telling users about breaches, weak passwords, duplicate (reused) items, and other security problems with saved items, which covers the core of the story. The release notes add that Watchtower flags logins that could be upgraded to passkeys, showing it actively surfaces security issues. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of exposed-password detection and how proactive alerts are delivered, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power user, the app warns me when a service I use is breached or a stored credential is weak, reused, or exposed

citations.quote: Watchtower tells you about breaches, weak passwords, duplicate items, and other security problems with the items you have saved in 1Password.
opening Watchtower in 1Password, which now flags all of your existing logins that could be updated with a passkey
